title: Transplant status and rejection
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's transplant status or transplant complication only.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for status post small bowel transplant.

HPI
61 y.o. male presents for routine follow-up. Pt had a small bowel transplant several years ago. He reports feeling well today. No abdominal pain, diarrhea, or weight loss. Denies any signs of organ rejection. Nutrition is excellent; pt reports good appetite and stable weight.

Medication List
Tacrolimus 2mg BID
Mycophenolate mofetil 500mg BID
Prednisone 5mg daily

Exam
General: Well-appearing, in no acute distress.
Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6 F.
Abdomen: Soft, non-tender, non-distended. Bowel sounds present.
Respiratory: CTAB.
Cardiovascular: RRR, no murmurs.

Assessment
1. Status post small bowel transplant. Stable on current immunosuppressive regimen. Nutrition is adequate. No evidence of rejection at this time.

Plan
1. Continue current medications as prescribed.
2. Continue monitoring labs.
3. Follow up in 6 months for routine check.

Electronically signed, K. Nguyen, DO, 05/12/2026
